voice.input_audio: Text, a speaker name from the 9 built-in voices and an optional style instruction in `instruct` [qwen3tts-gh]
voice.output_audio: A waveform and its sample rate returned by the qwen-tts package; the README does not state the rate [qwen3tts-gh]
voice.voices: 9 premium voices (Vivian, Serena, Uncle_Fu, Dylan, Eric, Ryan, Aiden, Ono_Anna, Sohee) across gender, age, language and Chinese dialects; no cloning in this model [qwen3tts-gh]
languages: Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish, Italian; each voice can speak all of them, with best quality in its native language [qwen3tts-gh]
voice.interruption: Not a conversation model: the client stops playback
voice.latency: Alibaba states end-to-end synthesis latency as low as 97 ms for the series in streaming mode [qwen3tts-gh]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Open weights, no price. A GPU is needed; no minimum memory is stated [qwen3tts-gh]
